result.analyst_notes: Mostly factual and descriptive, with first-person plural voice and superlative self-description such as 'world's largest' and 'unmatched'. Stated commitments are few and framed as commitment to E&P and innovation. Stakeholder emphasis is thin; the social-media feed adds employee and community examples, but these are not framed as values.
